description:
Goal
Remove realized recursive value trees from backend/interpreter/native lowering. Runtime-carried values are ShapeId or TransportPosition references plus lane spans/bundles, interpreted through TransportPlan facts.

Required changes
BackendValue and native RealizedValue stop carrying recursive TrashRuntimeValueLayout-like structure. Decode/encode routines take ShapeId or TransportPosition and read lane counts from TransportPlan. Tuple fields are views over child ShapeIds. DirectCallable values carry CallableId plus lane bundle; invocation reads callee/capture facts from CallableId. First-class callable publication reads BoundaryId contracts and does not mutate internal callable shape.

Resume rule
A resume payload position uses the producing return ShapeId from TransportPlan. Local ignored-use facts may drop lanes later, but they do not change the received shape. This preserves the fz-hwn.20 producer/resume shared-shape invariant.

Removal target
RealizedValue.layout tree, RealizedValue::tuple/direct_callable constructors that build layout, BackendValue recursive shape mirrors, encode_runtime_value/decode_runtime_value functions that match over old layout variants, tuple_fields_for_layout, direct callable reconstruction from nested captures, lane-count derivation by walking a local tree, and resume-shape derivation from local use demand.

Checks
Backend interpreter and native JIT agree on direct callable calls, tuple-field returns, resume delivery, reusable-cons flows, escaped callable boundaries, and ignored values. rg confirms no recursive runtime-value mirror remains in backend/native/interp.
title: Transport cutover: collapse runtime values to shape refs plus lane bundles
